title: land's refused move names a step with spaces, which coord transition refuses, so a stop at clean tree, fetch and rebase, rag.py eval, the push or merge request leaves the run key at landing
goal: land moves run/<id> to refused when it stops at any step, with a step field coord accepts (the step's name in an id-safe form, such as clean-tree), so stage-back is not refused afterwards and runs --reconcile has nothing left to repair

run:
import subprocess, tempfile, os, shutil, re, sys, json, glob
R = os.getcwd(); T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); S = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'c.sqlite')
env = dict(os.environ, KB_COORD_STORE=S)
def sh(*a): return subprocess.run(a, cwd=T, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
g = lambda *a: sh('git', '-c', 'user.email=a@b', '-c', 'user.name=n', *a)
g('init', '-q', '.'); g('commit', '-q', '--allow-empty', '-m', 'init')
shutil.copy(R + '/backlog.json', T); os.makedirs(T + '/kb/_self/backlog')
bl = lambda *a: sh(sys.executable, R + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', T, *a)
def c(*a): return subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/coord.py', '--store', S, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
sp = re.search(r'SP-\w+', bl('new', 'sprint', '--title', 'S', '--goal', 'g').stdout).group(0)
iid = re.search(r'ST-\w+', bl('new', 'story', '--title', 'Planted', '--goal', 'g', '--check', 'python3 -c pass').stdout).group(0)
for f in glob.glob(T + '/kb/_self/backlog/*.json'):
    d = json.load(open(f, encoding='utf-8'))
    if d['id'] == sp: d['status'] = 'active'
    if d['id'] == iid: d['status'] = 'doing'; d['sprint'] = sp
    json.dump(d, open(f, 'w', encoding='utf-8'), indent=2)
g('add', '-A'); g('commit', '-q', '-m', 'planted doing')
for s in ('claimed', 'working', 'returned'): c('transition', 'run/' + iid, '--to', s)
g('checkout', '-q', '-b', 'work/' + iid)
open(T + '/backlog.json', 'a').write('\n')
land = bl('land', iid)
out = land.stdout + land.stderr
step = re.search(r'land stopped at step ([^:\n]+):', out)
state = c('get', 'run/' + iid).stdout
ok = land.returncode == 1 and step is not None and ' ' in step.group(1).strip() and 'refused' in state
print('land', land.returncode, '| stopped at step', repr(step.group(1)) if step else None, '| run key', state.strip()[-40:])
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: Found by the SP-sucr3kfg review. coord.py transition takes a --field value only as an id with no spaces (kb/_self/coordination.md:46); bl_land.land_refused_step passes the step as the stop names it, and the move is refused with a warning. The check of ST-tb6tzrxa used the one-word step branch. The merge request step that gate g2 of ST-tb6tzrxa fixes for --wait-merge 0 has the same problem. Either map the name or widen what transition takes. Planning 2026-10-24: premise ran on today's base: the repro stops at step 'clean tree' and the run key stays landing. Recommended (of the note's two options): map the name, keep coord's closed id set: land_move_run passes ops_token(step) (clean-tree, rag.py-eval, merge-request) as the step field, the stop message keeps the readable name. The repro keeps a space in the message's step name, so it reads the field only through the final key state refused. Planned into SP-dx76osrn on 2026-10-24, sixth in the order.
